title: Customer totals joined to region
prompt: Return each customer's name, region, and total_spent (the sum of their order amounts). You must compute total_spent using a derived table in the FROM clause (a subquery that GROUP BYs orders by customer_id) and JOIN that derived table to the customers table to bring in name and region.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE customers13 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, region TEXT); INSERT INTO customers13 VALUES (1,'Acme','East'),(2,'Globex','West'),(3,'Initech','East'); CREATE TABLE orders13 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO orders13 VALUES (1,1,100),(2,1,150),(3,2,300),(4,2,50),(5,3,20);
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, c.region, ord.total_spent FROM customers13 c JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_spent FROM orders13 GROUP BY customer_id) ord ON ord.customer_id = c.id;
